title: Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita

thread.title: The World's Strongest Witch • Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters found the internet-based fantasy premise novel, amusing, and full of comedic potential.
The protagonist was often described as charming, funny, relaxed, and enjoyable to watch.
Several viewers liked the playful game-like presentation and pixel-art cutaways.
Some viewers enjoyed the silliness but worried that effortless victories could become repetitive.
A few commenters were interested in continuing, while others found the premiere slow or dull.
Multiple comments criticized the episode's limited setting, weak pacing, or lack of momentum.
Many comments complained about missing English subtitles on some Crunchyroll platforms.

title: Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2

thread.title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 • Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2 - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Several viewers were happy the series returned and enjoyed its unusual, highly eclectic mix of fantasy elements.
Some commenters found the character-focused material emotionally effective and praised the returning cast, especially the eccentric personalities.
Viewers were divided on the episode's very long premiere format: some welcomed the extra runtime, while others found it unexpected or excessive.
The episode's broad range of supernatural concepts appealed to some as distinctive and entertaining, but others felt the show was becoming increasingly overloaded.
Multiple commenters criticized the writing as scattered, with too many simultaneous threads and a lack of focus.
Some reactions objected to the episode's unusually dark and upsetting subject matter for a season premiere.
Several people said they had forgotten details from the first season and found the many returning storylines difficult to immediately follow.
